title: Second Drink: Halloween with Creed Bratton

sentences.en: Welcome to our second drink of Halloween.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到我们的第二期万圣节特饮节目。

sentences.en: According to pretty much every online poll, in fact, I didn't find one where this wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 根据几乎所有的在线民意调查，事实上，我没找到哪一个调查结果不是这样的。

sentences.en: Season two Halloween is ranked as the number one office Halloween episode.
sentences.zh: 第二季的万圣节集被评为《办公室》里最棒的万圣节集。
我觉得这也是我最喜欢的一集。

sentences.en: I loved our breakdown of this episode because we had Creed in the studio for the entire episode.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢我们对这一集的深度解析，因为克里德那一整集都在录音室里。

sentences.en: And he shared so many fun things.
sentences.zh: 他分享了好多有趣的事情。

sentences.en: And I actually panicked because I couldn't think of anything that we hadn't already shared about this episode.
sentences.zh: 其实我当时很慌，因为我想不出还有什么关于这一集是我们没分享过的。

sentences.en: You guys, Angela and I have been dividing up, taking the lead on second drinks, and I was assigned to Halloween and I did not know what we were going to do.
sentences.zh: 各位，安吉拉和我一直在分工负责“第二杯特饮”节目，这次轮到我负责万圣节这一集，我当时真不知道我们还能聊些什么。

sentences.en: I really felt like we shared it all.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得我们已经把能说的都说了。

sentences.en: I found my old MySpace blog for this episode.
sentences.zh: 我找到了我当时为这一集写的 MySpace 博客。

sentences.en: And there were several tidbits that we never shared.
sentences.zh: 里面有好些我们从未分享过的趣闻。

sentences.en: First off, Ange, in our breakdown, we talked about your cat costume and how your tail was very hard to sit in.
sentences.zh: 首先，安吉，在我们的解析里，我们聊到了你的猫咪装扮，还有那条尾巴让你坐着有多难受。

sentences.en: But according to my blog, one of the ears on your costume kept falling down and it was ruining takes.
sentences.zh: 但根据我的博客，你服装上的一只耳朵总是往下掉，搞得我们一直在重拍。

sentences.en: I do remember this because sometimes I could feel it fall and be flat on my head and other times I couldn't.
sentences.zh: 我记得，因为有时候我能感觉到它掉下来贴在头顶上，但有时候又感觉不到。

sentences.en: And so I would start talking and Oscar would be like, your ear is gone.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚开始说话，奥斯卡就会说，你的耳朵又掉了。

sentences.en: But I completely forgot about that until you reminded me.
sentences.zh: 直到你提醒我，我才完全想起来。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, yes, it was driving us crazy.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，噢，没错，那可真是把我们折磨疯了。

sentences.en: Well, I also shared that you broke several cookies in that scene that we had together in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 我还分享过你在会议室那场戏里弄碎了好几块饼干。

sentences.en: You know, the one where you ask me what I brought and I say brownies and you're like really pissed off because you're like same category as you brought cookies.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是你问我带了什么，我说布朗尼，然后你特别生气，因为你觉得那和饼干属于同一类。

sentences.en: And then I like slam the tray down.
sentences.zh: 然后我就把托盘重重地摔在桌上。

sentences.en: In my blog, I wrote this, quote, Angela kept slamming them down on the plate in disgust during the scene.
sentences.zh: 我在博客里是这么写的，引用一下：“安吉拉在拍那场戏时，一直厌恶地把饼干摔在盘子上。”
我其实记得我们当时笑场了。

sentences.en: I remember laughing because I broke them.
sentences.zh: 我记得我笑是因为我把饼干弄碎了。

sentences.en: And it's got to live somewhere in some blooper land.
sentences.zh: 那段花絮肯定还在某个地方存着。

sentences.en: It muSt. I mean, we talked about how that was a hard scene to get through, but I failed to mention that you were destroying cookies with one ear.
sentences.zh: 肯定在。我是说，我们聊过那场戏有多难拍，但我忘了提你当时是一只耳朵耷拉着在毁坏饼干。

sentences.en: Now, this episode also features the very first Jim and Pam air high five.
sentences.zh: 另外，这一集还有吉姆和帕姆的第一次空中击掌。

sentences.en: I know we talked about it because I love it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们聊过这个，因为我太喜欢那一幕了。

sentences.en: Yes, we discussed it, but we did not talk about how that was an improvisation.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们讨论过，但我们没提过那是即兴发挥。
那不是剧本里写的，女士。

sentences.en: So wait, it wasn't in the shooting draft?
sentences.zh: 等等，所以拍摄剧本里没有这一段？

sentences.en: No, I can't believe I didn't share this the first time.
sentences.zh: 没有，真不敢相信我第一次竟然没分享这个。

sentences.en: In fact, there wasn't any description in the script for how Pam reacts to Jim pretending to be Michael Scott on the phone.
sentences.zh: 事实上，剧本里根本没有描述帕姆在吉姆假装成迈克尔·斯科特打电话时该有什么反应。

sentences.en: He does this impression of Michael because they're tricking Dwight.
sentences.zh: 他模仿迈克尔是因为他们正在捉弄德怀特。

sentences.en: And when he hangs up, we do the air high five.
sentences.zh: 等他挂断电话，我们就击个空气掌。

sentences.en: But in the script, it says nothing.
It doesn't even say Pam looks delighted.
sentences.zh: 甚至没写帕姆看起来很高兴。

sentences.en: And my memory is that John suggested that we air high five to give it a little button at the end.
sentences.zh: 我记得是约翰提议我们击个空气掌，给结尾加点小点缀。

sentences.en: We nailed it the first time and everyone freaked out on how cute it was.
sentences.zh: 我们一次就成功了，大家都觉得这太可爱了，激动不已。

sentences.en: It's also the no look, the no look air high five.
sentences.zh: 而且还是那种不看对方的，不看对方的空气击掌。

sentences.en: It's like, oh, these two are in sync.
sentences.zh: 就像是，噢，这两个人真有默契。

sentences.en: What's going to happen with these characters?
sentences.zh: 这两个角色接下来会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, this is where it all began.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是一切开始的地方。

sentences.en: And then, Angela, according to my MySpace blog about this episode, Paul Lieberstein improvised a line in his scene with Steve that made Steve break.
sentences.zh: 然后，安吉拉，根据我当时写这集剧评的MySpace博客，保罗·利伯斯坦在他和史蒂夫的对手戏里即兴加了一句台词，让史蒂夫笑场了。

sentences.en: And I wrote that it took Steve two full minutes to recover.
sentences.zh: 我当时写道，史蒂夫足足花了整整两分钟才恢复过来。

sentences.en: And I'm like, wow, how did we not talk about this?
sentences.zh: 我心想，哇，我们怎么没聊过这个？

sentences.en: I checked our breakdown and sure enough, we had not discussed it.
sentences.zh: 我查了我们的剧集分析，果然，我们没讨论过。

sentences.en: There are not any scenes between Toby and Michael.
sentences.zh: 托比和迈克尔之间根本没有对手戏。

sentences.en: Oh, I must have written this MySpace blog before I knew what the episode was actually going to be when it aired.
sentences.zh: 噢，我一定是在这集播出前，还没确定最终成片内容时写的那个MySpace博客。

sentences.en: So there's this deleted scene where Toby asks Michael for the name of the employee that is going to be fired so that he can start the HR paperwork.
sentences.zh: 所以有个删减片段，托比问迈克尔要被解雇员工的名字，好让他开始准备人事文件。

sentences.en: And Michael tries to fire Toby.
sentences.zh: 然后迈克尔试图解雇托比。

sentences.en: I found it and I thought we should listen to it.
sentences.zh: 我找到了那个片段，觉得我们应该听听。

sentences.en: Michael, do you have the name of the employee?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你有那个员工的名字了吗？

sentences.en: I'd like to start working on our placement.
sentences.zh: 我想开始着手处理安置事宜了。

sentences.en: If you are so anxious to see a head roll, it's you.
sentences.zh: 如果你这么急着看人头落地，那个人就是你。

sentences.en: I don't report to you, Michael.
I report to the head of HR in New York.
sentences.zh: 我向纽约的人事部主管汇报。

sentences.en: Now you're not doing your job.
sentences.zh: 现在是你没在履行职责。
你为什么不干脆辞职呢？

sentences.en: If you just sent someone else, you need to have an HR representative.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是派别人去，你也需要有人事代表在场。

sentences.en: Just know that if I could have fired you, I would have.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，如果我能解雇你，我早就解雇你了。

sentences.en: I said that it was some improvisation that made Steve lose it.
sentences.zh: 我当时说是因为某种即兴发挥才让史蒂夫破功的。

sentences.en: I was clearly sitting in the background at reception observing this whole thing be shot.
sentences.zh: 我当时显然坐在接待处背景里，看着这一切被拍摄下来。

sentences.en: But I checked the script and it's exactly as scripted.
sentences.zh: 但我查了剧本，内容和剧本里写的一模一样。

sentences.en: So I guess maybe the improv didn't make it in the cut.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜即兴发挥的部分可能没被剪进正片里。

sentences.en: But I do know that if anyone could make Steve break, it was Paul.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道，如果有人能让史蒂夫笑场，那一定是保罗。

sentences.en: I feel like it's the moment just very resigned.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那一刻他表现得非常无奈。

sentences.en: Well, finally, Angela, I shared in my MySpace blog that Rain, John, and Brian held their first
sentences.zh: 好吧，最后，安吉拉，我在我的MySpace博客上分享过，雷恩、约翰和布莱恩在拍摄这一集期间，

sentences.en: ever PlayStation 2 boxing contest during our downtime for this episode.
sentences.zh: 举办了他们有史以来第一次PlayStation 2拳击比赛。

sentences.en: But I guess the episode finished shooting before they could finish the tournament.
sentences.zh: 但我猜在他们打完比赛之前，这一集就已经拍完了。

sentences.en: I noted that Rain and John were down to their final fighters.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时雷恩和约翰都只剩下最后一名选手了。

sentences.en: That just brings me right back.
sentences.zh: 这一下子把我带回了过去。

sentences.en: Those guys, we'd be in a scene and they'd be like, okay, last take, last take.
sentences.zh: 那些家伙，我们拍戏的时候，他们总会说，好了，最后一条，最后一条。

sentences.en: We're like, guys, are you doing your boxing match or are we doing the scene?
sentences.zh: 我们就会说，伙计们，你们是在打拳击比赛，还是我们要拍戏啊？

sentences.en: Well, that's a really fun second drink, lady.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这第二杯饮料真不错，女士。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, we hope you like this breakdown of Halloween.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，希望你们喜欢我们对《万圣节》这一集的解析。

sentences.en: Like Angela said, it's with our dear friend Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 就像安吉拉说的，这次我们请到了亲爱的朋友克里德·布拉顿。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正为你们制作终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集《办公室》，并分享独家幕后故事，

sentences.en: stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 这些故事只有我们两个亲历者才能告诉你们。
我们是《办公室》的女士们。

sentences.en: Creed's going to be with us for the whole episode, guys.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，克里德会全程陪着我们。

sentences.en: Okay, Creed, you are our first in-house visitor, right?
sentences.zh: 好的，克里德，你是我们第一位到访录音室的嘉宾，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we've had people call in, but you're our first in-house gueSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们之前有连线过嘉宾，但你是第一位亲临现场的。

sentences.en: I might have a bathroom break or something.
sentences.zh: 我可能得去上个厕所什么的。

sentences.en: It won't be for the whole thing, but I'll be in and out.
sentences.zh: 不会全程都在，但我会进进出出的。

sentences.en: We can provide you with a bathroom break.
sentences.zh: 我们可以为你提供上厕所的时间。

sentences.en: Well, I'm old, so that's part of it, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我老了，所以这也是原因之一，你知道的。

sentences.en: I need everybody to know that I've already teared up twice since Creed has been here.
sentences.zh: 我得让大家都知道，自从克里德来了之后，我已经掉过两次眼泪了。

sentences.en: You've said two touching – well, first of all, just seeing you.
sentences.zh: 你说了两件感人的事——首先，见到你本身就很感人。

sentences.en: Almost burst into tears, but then you've said like five amazing things that have touched
sentences.zh: 我差点就热泪盈眶了，但你又说了大概五件让我心头一暖的

sentences.en: As soon as I get together with you, it's just back – we're back on the set, you know,
sentences.zh: 只要和你聚在一起，那种感觉就回来了——我们就像回到了片场，你知道的，

sentences.en: and it's all like, oh, I miss you girls.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是，噢，我好想你们这些女孩。

sentences.en: Creed lives down the street from me.
sentences.zh: 克里德就住在我家那条街上。

sentences.en: I think everybody who knows me knows this.
sentences.zh: 我想认识我的人都知道这一点。

sentences.en: Don't give him my address, please.
sentences.zh: 请别把我的地址告诉他。

sentences.en: Creed's address is – his hidden key is – yes, we are neighbors, and it's one of the
sentences.zh: 克里德的地址是——他的备用钥匙藏在——没错，我们是邻居，能成为邻居是我

sentences.en: joys of my life that we're neighbors.
I love that you're right around the corner.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你就在转角处的感觉。
我们经常看到对方在散步。
我们经常看到对方在散步。

sentences.en: We see each other hiking around the street.
sentences.zh: 我们看到对方在街区附近徒步。

sentences.en: You were walking – was it your daughter's dog?
sentences.zh: 你当时在遛狗——那是你女儿的狗吗？
是我儿子的小约克夏犬，没错。

sentences.en: You're a little Yorkie, and I hear, hey, pumpkin, and I turn around, and it's Creed.
sentences.zh: 你带着小约克夏犬，然后我听到有人喊“嘿，小南瓜”，我一回头，是克里德。

sentences.en: And we've also maybe had some adult beverage and red solo cups.
sentences.zh: 而且我们可能还喝过点成人饮料，用那种红色塑料杯。

sentences.en: And we like to do a little bit of what we call the sauce trail and walk around having
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢做点我们称之为“微醺漫步”的事，就是边走边喝

sentences.en: Creed loves – anything where like animals go crazy, like planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 克里德喜欢——任何关于动物疯狂行为的节目，比如《地球脉动》。

sentences.en: Well, we are really excited to have you here.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们非常高兴你能来到这里。

sentences.en: We are discussing the Halloween episode.
sentences.zh: 我们正在讨论万圣节那一集。

sentences.en: This was written by Greg Daniels and directed by Paul Feig, and it is the first episode that
sentences.zh: 这一集由格雷格·丹尼尔斯编剧，保罗·费格执导，这是克里德开口说话的

sentences.en: In Diversity Day, I had lines with Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 在“多元化日”里，我和菲利斯有对手戏。

sentences.en: Well, the first AD – remember that girl we had, the first AD?
sentences.zh: 那个第一任助理导演——还记得我们那个女孩吗，第一任助理导演？

sentences.en: She thought I was part of the cast at the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时以为我是演员阵容里的。

sentences.en: So, Kate – she came and we had little hands and she said, now you and Phyllis just start
sentences.zh: 所以，凯特——她过来了，我们手里拿着小卡片，她说，现在你和菲利斯开始

sentences.en: Phyllis was going to out you.
Phyllis was going to out me.
And so, we started – and I started talking about, you know, sacrificing goats or something,
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始了——我开始谈论，你知道，献祭山羊之类的事情，

sentences.en: Trying to tell her what was on her head.
sentences.zh: 试图告诉她她头上贴的是什么。

sentences.en: Wait, your improv was sacrificing goats.
sentences.zh: 等等，你的即兴表演是献祭山羊？

sentences.en: So, you can hear me in the background.
sentences.zh: 所以，你能在背景音里听到我说话。

sentences.en: And then later they said, wait a minute, Creed's talking in the background.
sentences.zh: 后来他们说，等一下，克里德在背景里说话呢。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, shoot, how did that happen?
sentences.zh: 我说，噢，糟了，怎么会这样？
是啊，怎么会这样呢，克里德？

sentences.en: So, they paid me on the side, but they didn't say – but we can't – I said, no, it's
sentences.zh: 所以，他们私下付了我钱，但他们没说——我说，不，没

sentences.en: And then, not off camera, then I also was the voice for the ride.
sentences.zh: 然后，不是在镜头外，我还是那个游乐设施的配音。
是的，就是那个矿山游乐设施。

sentences.en: For the mining ride, you know.
sentences.zh: 就是那个矿山游乐设施，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think they paid attention to that one.
sentences.zh: 我想他们注意到了那一次。

sentences.en: Yeah, you were so funny as the voice of the mining ride.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你作为矿山游乐设施的配音真是太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And Isabel was watching that episode with me and she said, mom, I know that voice.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔当时和我一起看那一集，她说，妈妈，我认得那个声音。

sentences.en: And I was like, wait, you're – oh, my gosh.
She was like, I think it's Creed.
sentences.zh: 她说，我觉得那是克里德。

sentences.en: She is – I mean, I didn't catch it.
sentences.zh: 她——我是说，我都没听出来。

sentences.en: And then I looked it up and I'm like, Isabel, we do know that voice.
sentences.zh: 然后我查了一下，我说，伊莎贝尔，我们确实认得那个声音。

sentences.en: But anyway, this is the first time where I actually had some serious lines.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎么说，这是我第一次真正有了些重要的台词。

sentences.en: It was six and a half pages.
I remember Ken Zabornak threw the script down and said, okay, here it is.
sentences.zh: 我记得肯·扎博纳克把剧本往桌上一扔，说，好了，就是这个。

sentences.en: And I had memorized it forwards and backwards.
sentences.zh: 我把台词背得滚瓜烂熟，正着背倒着背都行。

sentences.en: I had set a timer on a little recorder at a night, subliminally at two and three in the
sentences.zh: 我还在夜里设了个小录音机的定时器，潜意识里在凌晨两三点的时候，

sentences.en: morning that would go off and play the lines while I was sleeping.
sentences.zh: 它就会自动播放，在我睡觉时把台词灌进脑子里。

sentences.en: I had it backwards and forwards.

sentences.zh: 我连倒着背都能背出来。

sentences.en: I knew this was the Rubicon.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是我的卢比孔河，是决定命运的时刻。

sentences.en: This is the place that I was going to get – because my intuition said, this is it.
sentences.zh: 这是我即将出头的地方——因为我的直觉告诉我，就是现在了。

sentences.en: And then, of course, we walk in the office and Greg, they came in and said, by the way,
sentences.zh: 然后，当然了，我们走进办公室，格雷格他们进来后说，顺便提一下，

sentences.en: we've made changes, of course, to the lines.
sentences.zh: 我们当然对台词做了一些改动。

sentences.en: We've reversed them around, add some new stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们把顺序调换了，还加了一些新内容。

sentences.en: You okay, Steve goes, yeah, fine.
sentences.zh: 你还好吗，史蒂夫说，嗯，没问题。

sentences.en: Because they used to do that to us all the time.

sentences.en: It probably would be someone making soup or which one's Pam.
sentences.zh: 可能是关于有人在煮汤的那句，或者是“哪个是帕姆”。

sentences.en: But I think, actually, I would have to be.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，实际上，我必须选那句。

sentences.en: In the 60s, I made love to many, many women, often outdoors in the rain and the mud.
sentences.zh: 在60年代，我和许多许多女人做过爱，经常是在雨中和泥里的户外。

sentences.en: It's possible a man slipped in.
sentences.zh: 有可能混进了一个男人。

sentences.en: There'd be no way of knowing.
And that is how you end an episode, my friend.
sentences.zh: 这就是结束一集节目的方式，我的朋友。

sentences.en: Oh, everyone, please join us next week when we will be talking about the fight.
sentences.zh: 哦，各位，请下周继续收听，我们将讨论“打架”那一集。
我们会想念你的，克里德。

sentences.en: Oh, I'd love to come back.
Thank you for listening to Office Ladies' Second Drink.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士的第二杯酒》。

sentences.en: This episode was initially created in collaboration with Earwolf.
sentences.zh: 本集最初是与Earwolf合作制作的。

sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由 Odyssey 出品，制作人为珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.zh: 我们的执行制作人是凯西·杰金斯，我们的音频工程师兼副制作人

sentences.zh: Odyssey 的执行制作人是珍娜·怀斯-伯曼和莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由克里斯·巴兹尔负责混音和母带处理。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿演唱的《橡胶树》。
